Do not bring your dog here. I’ve been taking my dog to PetSmart for years. This is the first time I’ve ever taken her to this location, and this will be the last. My dog has a profile at PetSmart. She was marked as a toy poodle and she’s registered with the AKC as a toy poodle. When I arrived to her PetSmart appointment, an employee tried to argue with me and tell me she’s not a toy poodle. She proceeded to show me photos of a toy poodle, and insisted my dog was not one. She added that there would be an additional fee because my dog was a “miniature poodle,” and not a toy poodle as PetSmart had her listed in the system. After the exchange, the manager was called over and confirmed that my dog was indeed a toy poodle, as I stated. Prior to her haircut session, I was notified that the desired length would be hard to achieve due to a few tangles. We agreed on a length, and I left the store. Ten minutes after my departure, I received a phone call that they found additional knots in her hair, and they would have to charge me a de-matting fee & cut her hair lower; I agreed. When I arrived, my dog’s hair was COMPLETELY SHAVED—down to the pink. I’ve had my dog for years and we’ve always gone to PetSmart, I’ve NEVER seen her cut this low. And it wasn’t just my dog. I witnessed them shaving multiple dogs—including a husky. I've attached a photo of my dog on the way to her appointment and after picking her up—she's unrecognizable. I’m so disappointed in my experience, and will not be returning. 0/10 would recommend.

This was one of the most disgusting and unacceptable experiences I’ve ever had in a pet store. I purchased a bag of dog food that I later discovered was infested with maggots, flies, and eggs. This is not only appalling, but also a serious health and safety hazard for animals.

When I brought this to the store’s attention, they did not show any care, concern, or accountability. Instead of addressing the issue, they simply refunded me. When I told them the product needed to be pulled from the shelf to protect other customers, I was told they “weren’t going to”, that they “don’t care”, and that “someone else will buy it.”

This behavior is beyond unacceptable. It shows a complete disregard for animal health, customer safety, and basic responsibility. Products with visible infestations should never remain on shelves. The lack of care and negligence here is dangerous and needs to be addressed by corporate immediately.

I will be sharing this information with the proper oversight authorities and if my dog gets sick as a result I will be filing a lawsuit. As a corporate owner and shareholder of multiple business, I can without a doubt tell the people of this city, this location needs to be closed, or management down to staff need to be fire and replaced.

I strongly urge PetSmart corporate to investigate this location and enforce proper standards before more pets and customers are put further at risk.
